title: Campaign
description: A Campaign defines a business objective and organizes Ad Squads. It provides aggregate statistics for all ad squads within it.

id.description: The unique identifier of the campaign

ad_account_id.description: The ID of the parent ad account

lifetime_spend_cap_micro.description: Lifetime spend cap in micro-currency units

start_time.description: The start time of the campaign

end_time.description: The end time of the campaign

objective_v2_properties.description: The objective properties for the campaign using the v2 objective format, which replaces the deprecated objective field.
